name: CFG++ history sampler (cfgpp_ud10_ab)
plain: A core-side CFG++ step with two-step Adams-Bashforth blending of the derivative. The step is built from the guided x0 and the negative's direction, then lerped with a linear-multistep estimate. An optional zero-sigma extrapolation adjusts the last step.
math:
d_u = (x−α_s·x̂_u)/σ_s, optional + w_u·(dt/dt_prev)·(d_u−d_u,prev)
E = α_t·x̂_cfg + σ_t·d_u − x, d = E/dt
x_t = x + lerp(E, c₁d + c₂d_prev, w_h)
Optional zero_weight blend at the final step uses history of denoised (order 1 or 2).
label: from code
surprise: Unlike other CFG++ samplers, it does not disable the cfg 1 skip; it falls back to cond_denoised when uncond is None.
